decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (PL-1115-11(Rev.B) and PL-1115-10 [received on 13 June 2018], and Existing Block Plan [received on 18 April 2018]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the outbuilding hereby permitted shall match those used on the main house.

Condition : 4 - The premises shall be used in a manner that is incidental to the main house (for example as a gym and garage with W/C) and for no other purpose. No primary living facilities shall be installed without prior notification of the Council.

Condition : 5 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the outbuilding hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The windows formed in the side elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
description: Erection of a single storey outbuilding to be used as a garage and gym at the rear of the house
